# dsh-github-panel
A GitHub console for DeepSeek Harness that runs inside the app: paste a personal access token once a
nd work with your repositories, issues, pull requests, commits, notifications, stars, cloning and sk
ills without opening github.com.
中文说明见下方 中文.
## Features
| Area | What you get |
| Repositories | List every repository you can access, search locally, browse the file tree and prev

iew file contents |
| Issues | Open/closed filter, create an issue, comment, close or reopen |
| Pul

l requests | List, inspect, comment, merge |
| Commits | Recent commits with author, message and tim

e |
| Notifications | Unread threads, mark one or all as read, jump to the referenced issue/PR |
| S

tars | Everything you starred, with instant unstar, and searching |
| Social | Who you follow, who f

ollows you, your organizations |
| Activity | Your public events and the events of the people you fo

llow |
| Clone | Clone a repo from your repositories, stars or search to disk, then keep it up to da

te automatically |
| Skills | Install a whole GitHub skill project into `~/.dsh/skills`, grouped by
category with Chinese descriptions and AI search keywords, and keep it in step with upstream |
Data is read from the GitHub REST API on every refresh, so the panel and github.com never drift apar
t. A background refresh runs every 60 seconds while the panel is visible.

## Connect

1. Create a token at <https://github.com/settings/tokens>.
- Classic token: `repo`, `read:user`, `no

tifications`.
- Fine-grained token: repository contents, issues and pull requests read/write, plus y

our profile.
2. Paste it into the panel and press **连接** / **Connect**. The token is verified with `
GET /user` before it is stored.
The panel lives in the web UI but every GitHub call is made by the host process, so no CORS proxy is
involved and the token never enters the browser.
## Where the token is stored
`$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/github-panel.json` (mode `0600`), i.e. `~/.dsh/plugin-data/github-panel.json`
on a default install. An older build wrote the token into the shared credential store; that record
is migrated to the file and removed on first read.
The panel does not share the token with anything else, and **断开** / **Disconnect** deletes it.
## Tools for the agent
The host half registers eight tools, so the agent can drive GitHub, the clone cache and the skill li
isters eight tools, so the agent can drive GitHub, the clone cache and the skill library on its own:
| Tool | Purpose |
| `github_api` | Call any GitHub REST endpoint (`method`, `path`, optional `body`) through the store

d token |
| `github_skill_list` | List skills in the local catalog with their source repository |
|
`github_skill_install` | Install `owner/repo` (optionally a `dir` and `ref`) into `~/.dsh/skills` |

| `github_skill_remove` | Remove an installed skill by name |
| `github_skill_project` | `list`, `in

stall` or `remove` a whole skill project (`repo`), with category, summary and keywords |
| `github_c

lone_list` | List local clones with branch, upstream, ahead/behind and dirty state |
| `github_clone

` | Clone `owner/repo` (optionally a `ref`) into the clone root |
| `github_clone_sync` | Fetch and
fast-forward one clone, or `all: true` |
## Cloning
Clones live in `$DSH_HOME/github-clones/<owner>/<repo>` (override with `DSH_GITHUB_CLONE_DIR`). Sync
is fetch + `merge --ff-only`:

- a clean clone follows the upstream branch automatically;
- a clone with local changes is left alon

e and reported as *dirty*, so your edits are never overwritten;
- a diverged clone is reported inste

*dirty*, so your edits are never overwritten;
- a diverged clone is reported instead of being reset.
Auto-sync runs every 15 minutes by default and can be switched off or re-timed in the panel. The pan
el shows a live progress bar (overall percentage plus the current git phase) while cloning or fetchi
shows a live progress bar (overall percentage plus the current git phase) while cloning or fetching.
Git must be installed and on `PATH`. On Windows the panel runs git with `http.sslBackend=openssl`, w
hich avoids the Schannel `SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS` failure some machines hit.

## Security notes

- Every host route checks the request origin, so other pages cannot drive the panel.
- The RPC proxy
only accepts paths that start with `/` and rejects absolute URLs, so it cannot be pointed at anothe
the plugin is installed straight from this repository.
## Limitations

- One account per installation.
- File preview is capped at 300 KB, clone progress at the phases git

reports.
- Merging uses the plain merge commit strategy; no rebase/squash choice yet.
### 功能

- **仓库**：列出你有权限的仓库，搜索、浏览目录、预览文件（300 KB 以内）。
- **克隆**：从「我的仓库 / 星标 / 搜索」一键克隆到 `~/.dsh/github-clones`，显

示实时进度条（整体百分比 + 当前 git 阶段）；作者更新后自动 fetch + 快进合并，本地有改动时停下不动你的文件；默认每 15 分钟检查一次，可关闭或改间隔。
- **星标 / 关注 / 动

态**：实时读自 GitHub，星标可一键取消。
- **技能**：填 `owner/repo`（可加子目录与分支）把含 `SKILL.md` 的技能装进 `~/.dsh/skills`；也可以直接点
克隆行上的「安装」，把整个仓库的技能一次性作为「项目」装进来。项目和技能都自动带中文简介、用途大类（漫剧 / 图像设计 / 视频音频 / 开发工具 / 文档办公 / 数据分析 / 自动化）+ 细分小类
（如 漫剧 → 大纲改编 / 剧本台词 / 人物角色 / 美术场景 / 分镜镜头 / 站位调度），并写入 AI 检索关键词（`whenToUse`）。「检查更新」和每 15 分钟的自动同步会按上游最新

提交重装，技能库不会落后；已安装的克隆行显示绿色「已安装」，不再重复出现安装按钮。
- **通知**：未读列表、单条或全部标记已读、点击跳到对应议题/PR。
- **访客模式**：连接卡底部的「邀请码
」可打开只读的公开数据视图（公开仓库、星标、动态），不需要令牌，也拿不到任何私有内容。
